purpose: Frozen scientific universe used to reproduce the manuscript-level morphology validation analyses.
city_name_note: City names are recorded only as trailing record labels. City names are not used in any computation. The frozen roster mapping was verified against the canonical city roster produced by the frozen validation-city nomination chain.

selection_definition.ALL: every frozen analysis window of that city and scale

missing_height_rule: A window without valid building-height support keeps a missing height value. Missing height is never replaced by zero and missing windows are never re-weighted or imputed.
validation_classification_order: SIGN_REVERSAL if at least one defined coefficient is negative
SAME_SIGN if Spearman rho > 0 and weighted Pearson r > 0
UNDEFINED otherwise (including zero or undefined coefficients after the minimum-window gate passes)

statistic_definitions.spearman_rho: Pearson correlation of the average ranks of x and y over the pairwise-finite windows. No p-value is computed.
statistic_definitions.weighted_pearson_r: Weighted covariance divided by the weighted standard deviations of x and y using the frozen relationship weight. No p-value is computed.

prohibited: raw 50 m data reads for the paper-reproduction level
coefficient re-estimation in the synthesis stage
